For evaluation, we employ several metrics: Exact Match (EM), F1-Score, Precision (P), and Recall (R) ... Additionally, for semantic evaluation, we employ BERTScore-F1 (B).

For evaluation, we employ several metrics: Exact Match (EM), F1-Score, Precision (P), and Recall (R) to assess the correctness of predicted answers. These metrics are implemented using the same codebase as Hybrid-QA. Additionally, for semantic evaluation, we employ BERTScore-F1 (B) and utilize the bert-base-uncased model for computing similarity matching.
